newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-ENQVIST LEVELS DAVIS CUP TIE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ENQVIST LEVELS DAVIS CUP TIE.

text.p: Sweden's top player Thomas Enqvist levelled the Davis Cup final against France on Friday when he beat Arnaud Boetsch in straight sets.
Earlier, Stefan Edberg had lost the opening singles against Cedric Pioline, also in three sets, after falling heavily and twisting his ankle.
Edberg, due to retire after the Davis Cup, said after his 6-3 6-4 6-3 defeat that his ankle injury could force him to miss his second singles against Boetsch on Sunday.
"If I am not feeling close to 100 per cent it would be very hard to play. It would not be fair to me or anyone else."
Enqvist continued his outstanding form of recent months with a clinical 6-4 6-3 7-6 win over Boetsch.
After breaking Boetsch's serve at the end of the first set, the lanky Swede wore down his opponent, firing powerful baseline shots around the court.
He took the third set tiebreak 7-2 after both players had broken service once.
